13:00 │ EN VIVO AHORA: State of the Union With Jake Tapper and Dana Bash
Jake Tapper and Dana Bash bring together major newsmakers, analysts and experts to tackle in-depth coverage of the 2026 Midterm elections, tracking the key races, latest polling and issues shaping the final stretch to Election Day.

14:00 │ A CONTINUACIÓN: Fareed Zakaria GPS
Fareed Zakaria brings viewers his insights and analysis, and interviews world leaders, artists, scientists, business leaders, global affairs analysts and other cultural observers for the 'Global Public Square.'
